div.head: Cn 1020 16
div.ab: ⁊ eac we beodað on Godes ælmihtiges naman ⁊ on ealra his haligra, þæt nan man swa dyrstig ne sy, þæt on gehadodre nunnan oððe on mynecenan gewifige;
⁊ eac we beodað on Godes ælmihtiges naman ⁊ on ealra his haligra, þæt nan man swa dyrstig ne sy, þæt on gehadodre nunnan oððe on mynecenan gewifige.
And eac we beodað on Godes ælmihtiges naman and on ealra his haligra, þæt nan man swa dyrstig ne sy þæt on gehadodre nunnan oððe on mynecenan gewifige.
Und ferner gebieten wir im Namen des allmächtigen Gottes und in dem aller seiner Heiligen, dass niemand so frech sei, dass er mit einer eingesegneten Nonne oder mit einer Mönchin sich beweibe;
And further we command in the name of Almighty God and of all his saints that no one be so presumptuous as to marry a consecrated nun or a nun of a rule;
And likewise we enjoin, in the name of God Almighty and of all his Saints, that no man be so presumptuous as to take to wife a professed nun or a woman who has taken religious vows.
And also we command in the name of God Almighty and of all his saints, that no man is to be so presumptuous as to take to wife a woman dedicated to God or a nun.
And we also command, in the name of almighty God and all of his saints, that no man be so bold as to wed a nun in orders or a woman under monastic vows.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
